caption: The drawing features two objects against a light beige background: on the left is a gray container with a cylindrical body that has a slightly domed, ridged neck at the top, and an intricate relief of leaves and clusters of small berries wrapping around the central portion of the container; on the right is a small, gray, stackable cup or tumbler, depicted with five visible segments separated by horizontal lines and a single gold or brass-colored band around the middle segment; the word "stewart" is written in lowercase letters just below and to the right of the cup, with the "S" stylized and set apart from the other letters. There are no additional objects, designs, or backgrounds present in the drawing.
